subject: showing lines and points using different factors

messages.author: 30d7b1c2c06eb1f7
messages.subject: showing lines and points using different factors
parts:
I am trying to produce a figure showing the fitted relationship
between two variables (a, b). I have multiple years of data. I have
broken these data down into two periods that I call "past" and
"present". I would like to use stat_smooth to show the two fitted
lines for the two periods, however, I would like to show the data
points by year. Is it possible to produce this type of figure so that
the legend shows the appropriate line type with the respective year
symbol? Below I have some hypothetical data and my attempt to achieve
my objectives. As you can see, I get stuck at stat_smooth. Any help
is greatly appreciated.


a <- c(5,6,7,8,9,5,6,7,8,9,5,6,7,8,9)
b <- c(500,600,700,800,900,501,599,701,799,901,400,500,600,700,800)
year <-
c("1940","1940","1940","1940","1940","1960","1960","1960","1960","1960","2010","2010","2010","2010","2010")
period <-
c("past","past","past","past","past","past","past","past","past","past","present","present","present","present","present")
data <- data.frame(cbind(age,tl,year,period))
data


plot <- ggplot(data=data, aes(x=a, y=b))
plot + geom_point(aes(color=factor(year), shape=factor(year)),
size=5) +
scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","black","black"),
breaks=c("1940","1960","2010"), labels=c("1940","1960","2010")) +
scale_shape_manual(values=c(1,2,16),
breaks=c("1940","1960","2010"), labels=c("1940", "1960","2010")) +
stat_smooth(method='lm', aes(color=factor(period),
line=factor(period))) +
scale_linetype_manual(values=c(2,7), breaks=c("past","present"),
labels=c("Past", "Present"))

parts:
Your example wasn't really reproducible, but I patched it together...

age <- c(5,6,7,8,9,5,6,7,8,9,5,6,7,8,9)
tl <- c(500,600,700,800,900,501,599,701,799,901,400,500,600,700,800)

year <-
c("1940","1940","1940","1940","1940","1960","1960","1960","1960","1960","2010","2010","2010","2010","2010")
period <-
c("past","past","past","past","past","past","past","past","past","past","present","present","present","present","present")

data1 <- data.frame(cbind(age,tl,year,period))
data1
ggplot(data=data1, aes(x=age, y=tl)) +
geom_point(aes(color=factor(year), shape=factor(year)),size=5) +
scale_colour_manual(values=c("black","black","black"),breaks=c("1940","1960","2010"), labels=c("1940","1960","2010"))+
scale_shape_manual(values=c(1,2,16),breaks=c("1940","1960","2010"), labels=c("1940", "1960","2010")) +
stat_smooth(method='lm', aes(color=factor(period), line=factor(period), group=period)) +

I think your problem was the group= argument. 

B

parts: It's a good question. Usually to merge legends they have to have the same breaks and labels.

stat_smooth(method='lm', aes(color=factor(year), line=factor(year), group=year)) +

scale_linetype_manual(values=c(2,2,7),breaks=c("1940","1960","2010"), labels=c("1940", "1960","2010"))

The trouble is that when you do this you get individual lines for 1940 and 1960... Is that ok?

I'm not sure I know how to split it. When I tried group=period I got the following error:
Error in grid.Call.graphics(L_polygon, x$x, x$y, index) : 
  invalid line type
